name: Workflow
description: Element type for processes with steps, assignees and actions (e.g. an HR application process): a form starts a case, each step is handled by a user, group or role, every decision is recorded.
author: Enterprise Wiki

permissions.label: Create workflows
permissions.description: Create workflows and change or delete your own ones (with their steps and assignees).

permissions.label: Workflow administrator
permissions.description: Change and delete all workflows of the category. Every change is logged in detail and the creator is notified.

permissions.label: Manage cases
permissions.description: See all cases of the workflows, cancel them and decide about failed steps. Who carries out a step is defined only by its assignee.
